mapper.sql: id, tree_code, name, species, family, genus, protection_level, age, height, latitude, longitude, `desc`, is_delete, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tree WHERE is_delete = 0 ORDER BY tree_code
SELECT FROM tree WHERE is_delete = 0 AND (species LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%') OR name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%'))
SELECT FROM tree WHERE id = #{id} AND is_delete = 0
SELECT FROM tree WHERE tree_code = #{treeCode} AND is_delete = 0
SELECT DISTINCT family FROM tree WHERE is_delete = 0 AND family IS NOT NULL AND family != '' ORDER BY family
SELECT DISTINCT genus FROM tree WHERE is_delete = 0 AND family = #{family} AND genus IS NOT NULL AND genus != '' ORDER BY genus
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tree (tree_code, name, species, family, genus, protection_level, age, height, latitude, longitude, `desc`, is_delete, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{treeCode}, #{name}, #{species}, #{family}, #{genus}, #{protectionLevel}, #{age}, #{height}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{desc}, 0, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
